newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks reverse losses to close at highs.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks reverse losses to close at highs.

text.p: Madrid stock indices reversed direction in late trade on Thursday to close at new highs as the bullish tone seen in recent sessions refused to die.
The General index closed up 0.45 points, 0.12 percent, to 385.14. The Ibex-35 rose 6.47 points, 0.15 percent, to close at 4,433.72.
Stocks spent most of session trading in negative territory in what traders saw as a consolidation to Wednesday's gains.

"The fall in other major stock markets and bonds enabled Spanish stocks to take a breather after recent gains, but no-one really wanted to sell and the trend continued to be bullish," said one trader.
But trade was thin with turnover reaching only 28.0 billion pesetas.

Trading focussed on blue-chip stocks, traders said. Telefonica accounted for 15.3 percent of total turnover, closing unchanged at 2,645. Iberdrola closed down five pesetas at 1,420 after absorbing 12.43 percent of trade.
